test_case_title: TC-002 Equipment Action Reason Configuration - Blank Reason Validation
test_steps: Clear all browser cookies and cache
Enter email address in the email field
Enter password in the password field
If cookies acceptance popup appears, click on Accept button
Click on Configuration icon from the left menu
Verify Equipment Action Reason Configuration section is displayed
Verify Equipment Action Reason Configuration table shows Action, Reason, and Audit History columns with Add and Delete controls
Click on Add button in Equipment Action Reason Configuration section
Select 'Cancelled' action from the Action dropdown
Leave the Reason text box empty/blank
Click outside of the Reason text box to trigger validation
expected_results: Browser cookies and cache are cleared successfully
Login with Despachoprevio button is clicked and redirects to login page
Email address is entered in the email field
Next button is clicked and password page loads
Password is entered in the password field
Sign in button is clicked and user is authenticated
Cookies acceptance popup is handled if present
Equipment Action Reason Configuration section is visible with proper table structure
Table displays Action, Reason, and Audit History columns with Add and Delete controls
Add form/dialog appears for creating new equipment action reason
Cancelled action is selected from dropdown
Validation error appears indicating that Reason field is required/mandatory
preconditions: Valid DSP user credentials available in DSP_USERNAME and DSP_PASSWORD environment variables
DSP application base URL configured in DSP_BASE_URL environment variable
User has permissions to access Configuration section
User has permissions to manage Equipment Action Reason Configuration
